audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text credited Diana's resets to "Moonlight Vigil", an ability she does not have.
audit.why: Her R is Moonfall. The reset is on Lunar Rush (E): it has no cooldown when dashing to a target afflicted with Moonlight from Crescent Strike.
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text and wants.foe[2] re-attributed to Lunar Rush resets off Moonlight.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and the page never states that Justice Punch's knockup stops Lunar Rush mid-dash.
audit.why: Crescent Strike is 8s at rank 1 and 6s at rank 5; Lunar Rush is 22s at rank 1 unless the target carries Moonlight; Pale Cascade is 15s; Moonfall 100s. Galio's E knocks up the first champion it reaches.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field carries all four numbers and the reset condition; dosFull[1].d now states the E-into-Lunar-Rush interaction instead of repeating tradeGood.

edits.before: - Diana Crescent Strike: matchup-defining — Moonlight marks reset her dash — sidestep the arc and her dive has no follow-up. It governs your forward steps. - W Shield of Durand spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Crescent Strike (Q): 8s at rank 1, 6s at rank 5 — dodge the arc and Lunar Rush stays on its 22s cooldown instead of resetting. - Moonfall: 100s at rank 1. - Pale Cascade shield is 15s at rank 1; trade after the third sphere pops, not before.

edits.after: She has to be next to you to do damage — start the W charge as Lunar Rush leaves the ground and the taunt lands as she arrives.

notes: Fabricated ability killed: two content fields credited Diana with 'Moonlight Vigil'. Her R is Moonfall and the reset lives on Lunar Rush (no cooldown when dashing to a Moonlight-afflicted target). Chart: sides were all 'Skill' against a win[] of Galio x4 / Diana x3 from the packet — sides aligned, no win[] edit needed since win[] was already right. spikes[1].text calls Moonfall an engage 'into her Crescent Strike spin'; Diana has no spin ability in the kit file, but the phrase does not name a fake ability so I left it — worth a look. missingInteractions supplied the Justice-Punch-stops-Lunar-Rush interaction; the kit confirms Galio's E knocks up the first champion hit, so I wrote it as a knockup mid-dash rather than a hard 'denies the dash'.
